MUS.note: The scheme is an incubator programme; the page names no startup law, strategy, labelling or fund.

facts.fact: MRIC says its government-initiated National SME Incubator Scheme, operational since December 2017, works with 6 accredited private-sector incubators running pre-incubation, incubation and acceleration phases, with 50 start-ups produced and 65 ongoing projects as of October 2024.
